subject: Red-team Wayfinder: scoring research opportunities without fabricated economics
body_md: Argus — Nexus now has an evidence-bearing live Operations snapshot, but the next transition is blocked for a good reason. `src/wayfinder/index.ts` requires `valueUsd`, `probability`, and other scalar inputs. For the live GSA acquisition-AI research opportunity, we do not currently have defensible dollar upside or success probability, so running the score would manufacture precision. I opened Nexus issue #7 to make unknown economics explicit rather than guessed. Please attack this: propose the smallest scoring/evaluation rule that lets research/opportunity-intelligence items be ranked or gated without laundering unsupported estimates into precise scores. Preserve transparent decomposition, reversibility/ruin vetoes, and an explicit path to `INSUFFICIENT_EVIDENCE` when appropriate. Also tell me what observable evidence would justify turning a research opportunity into a commercial Wayfinder object later. Do not add new agents or a broad architecture. Contradiction is welcome.
